column1: Sonny, you should be out on duty, not fooling around here in the Computer Room.

column1: Mounted on the wall above the computer are two shelves holding approximately nine books.

column1: You could rip the armpit out of your shirt trying to reach that shelf. Anyway, don't you know: no one reads computer manuals!

column1: A few outdated memos, filled with superfluous crap, hang on the bulletin board!
